issuing_body: European Commission / AI Office – Working Group 1 (GPAI Code of Practice)
prohibited_practices: circumventing effective technological measures (paywalls, subscription models) when web-crawling
scraping content from websites persistently and repeatedly infringing copyright on a commercial scale
generating outputs that reproduce copyright-protected training content in an infringing manner
copyright-infringing uses of a model as prohibited in acceptable use policies
enforcement_authorities: Court of Justice of the European Union
penalties_summary: The Code itself does not impose penalties; non-compliance may give rise to liability under Union law on copyright and related rights. Underlying AI Act obligations (Articles 53 and 55) carry their own enforcement regime. Adherence to the Code does not constitute conclusive evidence of compliance with the AI Act.
implementation_notes: This is the Copyright Chapter of the broader GPAI Code of Practice, intended to help Signatories demonstrate compliance with Article 53(1)(c) of the EU AI Act. Adherence is voluntary and does not constitute compliance with Union copyright law per se. Measures are proportionate to provider size, with SME/startup considerations. A dynamic list of copyright-infringing websites will be maintained on an EU website to assist compliance with Measure 1.2.
